notes: Phase 3E.2B: N09 is the user's natural digit-by-digit pronunciation (this pair's framing is intentionally reversed from the others -- see Phase 3E.2B task notes); N10 is a hundreds-form control. Verified current behavior: N09 -> 'Section 506 IPC' (correct); N10 -> 'Section 5 hundred six IPC' ('hundred' outside the parser's vocabulary; only the 'five'->5 prefix is consumed and replaced, same class as the D03 finding). The statute token's lowercase spokenForm is a proactive fixture choice (Phase 3E.2A's D03 finding showed real-audio casing varies unpredictably) -- not evidence that this specific case produced lowercase text.
